title: Print the sum, difference, product, floor division, remainder, and power of 3 and 6. (Challenge 1)
description: Print the sum, difference, product, floor division, remainder, and power of 3 and 6.
hints: Identify the main Python concept: arithmetic operators.
Write a small, direct solution and check indentation.
Compare each printed line with the expected output.
solution:
a = 3
b = 6
print(a + b)
print(a - b)
print(a * b)
print(a // b)
print(a % b)
print(a ** 2)
explanation: This exercise practices arithmetic operators. The solution uses the relevant Python feature and prints the required result.
commonMistakes: Forgetting correct indentation or punctuation.
Printing extra text that changes the expected output.
